notes: «وجده، من قبل أمه» is the grandfather named by relation; «من قبل أمه» is a descriptor and not part of any surface. The grandfather is named only as أبو ذباب, which is written as a kunya and not identified.
The last «عن جده» is a bare relation, and the words «قال كان خاتم النبي» are his, so he is the last link. The closing remark about المعيقيب is no link.
